source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
From this section this week, we will focus on failed tests from a genuine test record.
3. Here is an appliance / electrical cord with a Class 1 plug with a flexible cable that has failed.
4. A double insulated appliance with a two pin plug with a flexible cable has failed.
5. Next is the testing section which shows the results of this test.
6. Zero Ohms Earth Electrode Resistance is a sure sign of a failed cable.
7. In the lower section of this test form should be the defect area.
8. Note the type of defect, i.e. if the flexible lead or cord is damaged, or if any other part of the appliance, plug, etc has failed.
9. Replace the plug, socket or flexible lead.
10. Make sure you mark the tested / passed appliances in some way to ensure they are included in the next test cycle.
11.
